_doc: 24 V enclosed switching supplies, by current: Mean Well's LRS series. Unbranded boxes sold by a round current are community until measured (their makers publish no drawings): choose an LRS model at or above the current you need here, or measure yours. The default is LRS-100-24; the variants carry each model's current and body. kind as in x1c.json. Body in the x-y plane, the long side along x.
